# nomatron_role (Data Source)

Fetch a single Nomatron role by exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_role" "example" {
  name = "viewer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact role name.

### Read-Only

- `built_in` (Boolean) Whether the role is built in.
- `description` (String) Role description.
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permission strings assigned to the role.
- `scope` (String) Role scope selector.
